title: Mid-Century Desert Club Resort Pool & Mountains, 1953 California Vintage Photo
description: A scenic view of the outdoor swimming pool at The Desert Club in December 1953, showcasing sleek mid-century modern streamline architecture against a backdrop of rugged desert mountains and palm trees. Sunbathers and swimmers in period swimwear relax beside large fringed umbrellas and lawn chairs, reflecting the postwar boom of glamorous desert getaway culture in Southern California.
